# stems-mcp

Audio stem separation using HTDemucs v4 via ONNX Runtime.

## Docs
- README: [README.md](README.md)
- Full docs: [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt)

## Quick start
```powershell
uv sync --extra gpu && uv run stems-mcp   # or --extra cpu (pick exactly one)
```
HTTP mode: `uv run stems-mcp --mode http` on port 11126.

## Key tools
- `stems_separate(operation="separate", input_path, output_dir)` — 4 stems
- `stems_separate(operation="separate_vocals", input_path, output_dir)` — 2 stems
- `stems_separate(operation="status")` — model/CUDA status
